objective: Record the approval-gap bypasses that let the batch and two dependency bumps merge, as the branch-protection procedure requires.
decision_supported: May an administrator bypass the approving-review requirement? Only when recorded before use, with the waived item named.
acceptance: Each bypass names its reason, commit, waived item and approving owner.
No required status check was waived.
evidence: checker reports the live configuration matches the declaration
stop_conditions: The record would need to justify waiving a status check.
risks_and_fallbacks: A recorded bypass is still a bypass; the record exists so it is auditable, not so it is routine.
